note:
⛔ SNG-450 MIND BATCH 1 — MERGED ABILITIES. Three skills replacing seven, per Erik's review.
⚠️ THE MERGE TEST WAS FLAVOUR-DUPLICATION AT IDENTICAL STATS: The Clear Path / Derived Route / Patterned Way were all L2, mag4, energy 1, with the same three-rank arc and only the noun changed (calculating / reasoning / pattern). The Correct Protocol / Restored Form were both L2, 2d4, energy 2, same arc. The Stated Case / Necessary Case did the same job at different costs.
⛔ FLAVOUR IS NOW INTERNAL — each carries a `sectFlavour` map so a cogitant, syllogist and figurist describe the same craft in their own terms without it being three entries.

abilities.name: Solved Route

crit.success: The line you take is shorter than anyone thought the ground allowed.
crit.failure: The route was correct an hour ago.

abilities.description: Work out the way through before you take a step, and then take it — the quickest line through a crowd, a ruin, a guard rotation or open country, walked as though you had been given the plan.
abilities.narrationHints: They do not hesitate at junctions. The gap opens a half-second before they reach it, every time, and it looks like luck until the fourth time.

sectFlavour.cogitant: You CALCULATE it — the crowd modelled, the rotation timed.
sectFlavour.syllogist: You REASON it — what must be true of a place you have not seen.
sectFlavour.figurist: You READ ITS FORM — the space is an instance of a shape you know, and shapes have exits.

tree.name: Route
tree.grants: Find and walk the fastest safe line through any space you can observe. You do not backtrack and you do not get lost.
tree.cannot: Only what you can see or have been described. Does not make you faster, only better-directed.

tree.name: Moving Space
tree.grants: ⛔ THE SPACE IS NOW ALLOWED TO MOVE. Cross a shifting one — a crowd, a patrol, a running fight — without friction, staying two steps ahead of everyone in it. Adds unseen ground: derive the route through terrain you have not entered.
tree.cannot: Cannot route around what you have no information about at all.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ r2 lets the space MOVE — a crowd, a patrol, a running fight. That is a condition you can now operate in, held for the crossing.

tree.name: Designed Scene
tree.grants: ⛔ WALK A WHOLE PARTY THROUGH ON YOUR LINE, calling it as you go — and hold the route through a space actively working against you: a rout, a fire, a collapsing floor.
tree.cannot: They must follow closely and trust it; one person breaking away breaks their own line, not yours.
tree._grantsWas: ⚠️ ADDS OTHERS. In a space you understand, you move as though you laid it out — and you can walk a whole party through on the same line, calling it as you go.
tree._rebalance: ⚠️ Was scope-only ('as though you laid it out'). Targets + conditions is the same fiction with a mechanical edge.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS THE PARTY AND HOSTILE GROUND. Walk a whole group through on your line, calling it as you go — and hold the route through a space that is actively working against you: a rout, a fire, a collapsing floor.

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-450: MERGES The Clear Path (cogitant), The Derived Route (syllogist) and The Patterned Way (figurist) — three skills at the same level, same magnitude, same energy, same three-rank arc, differing only in the noun. Erik: 'yes on the nav skills.' Flavour is now internal.

intensity.surge: the whole route at once, and you will take it whatever is on it

abilities.plainly: A movement action that finds and walks the best line. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10.
abilities.notFor: Ground you have no information about at all; outrunning anyone (it directs, it does not hasten); a space that changes faster than you can read it.

bounds.text: you must be able to observe, reason about, or read the form of the space
directs, never hastens — it does not make you faster
holding the route occupies your attention while you walk it

abilities.name: Physician's Tome

crit.success: You find the fault under the fault, and both close.
crit.failure: You treat what is visible. What is not gets a clear run at them.

abilities.description: Find what is actually wrong and put it right — by procedure or by pattern, but correctly, so that it does not come back.
abilities.narrationHints: No comfort offered and none needed. They find the thing, name it, and fix it, and the patient is left slightly unnerved by how little reassurance was involved.

sectFlavour.syllogist: BY PROTOCOL — the correct actions in the correct order, nothing left out.
sectFlavour.figurist: BY FORM — you restore the pattern the thing is a disruption of, and function follows.
sectFlavour.cogitant: BY MODEL — you hold the whole working in your head and correct it there first.

tree.name: Diagnosis and First Care
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME WHAT IS ACTUALLY WRONG — the real fault, not the presenting one — AND TREAT IT. A small heal on top of the diagnosis: the bleeding stopped, the joint set, the fever broken tonight.
tree.cannot: One patient or one object; the fault must be present, not historical.

tree.name: Full Sequence
tree.grants: ⚠️ A BIG HEAL. The whole correct sequence, in order, nothing left out — they get up, and they can fight or walk today.
tree.cannot: Cannot regrow what is gone; cannot work on what you cannot examine.

tree.name: Root and Branch
tree.grants: ⛔ A FULL HEAL — whole, to the bone, in one working — and you can carry it to a SECOND subject in the same working if they are within reach.
tree.cannot: Two subjects at most, and you must be able to reach the whole of each.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ A FULL HEAL. Whole, to the bone, in one working — and the same for an object or a system: back to what it was before.
tree._rebalance: ⚠️ Was scope+quality where scope meant nothing (a heal has no area). Targets is the honest second axis.

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-450: MERGES The Correct Protocol (syllogist) and The Restored Form (figurist) — identical level, dice, energy and rank arc. Erik: 'yes on the restore skills, but LEVEL ONE SHOULD HEAL A BIT ON TOP OF THE DIAGNOSIS.' ⚠️ ERIK: 'HEALED IS HEALED — permanence isn't a good r3. Perhaps r2 should be a BIG HEAL and r3 a FULL HEAL.' The ladder is now small → big → full, which is a quantity a player can read.

intensity.conserve: treat the presenting complaint properly and no further
intensity.surge: ⛔ WORK THE WHOLE CASE THROUGH; you will find what else is wrong and they may not want to know

abilities.plainly: A social/investigate action that restores health. It rolls 2d4.
abilities.notFor: Regrowing what is gone; anything you cannot examine; comfort — this craft does not reassure.

bounds.text: the fault must be present and examinable, not historical
you must reach the whole of it to treat the root
⚠️ the practitioner carries the fatigue of the correction

abilities.name: Case Closed

crit.success: The room arrives at it before you finish, and someone else says the last line for you.
crit.failure: They find the loose premise. The case comes apart in front of everyone and takes your standing with it.

abilities.description: Lay a matter out so completely that the argument ends — and at its height, walk one person to the conclusion that ends them.
abilities.narrationHints: Nobody is humiliated and nobody is shouted down. The room simply arrives somewhere and stays there, and afterwards no one can quite remember what the disagreement was.

sectFlavour.syllogist: THE LAID-OUT CASE — premises in order, and the conclusion is simply visible.
sectFlavour.cogitant: THE CLOSED ARGUMENT — no gap for them to find, because there isn't one.
sectFlavour.figurist: THE WHOLE FIGURE — you show them the shape the facts make, and it is not arguable.

tree.name: Matter Settled
tree.grants: ⛔ SET A MATTER OUT TO PEOPLE WILLING TO FOLLOW. A dispute resolves, a council decides, a wrong belief comes apart, and it stays resolved.
tree.cannot: They must be willing to follow. Does nothing to someone who refuses to engage.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ SET A MATTER OUT TO PEOPLE WILLING TO FOLLOW. A dispute resolves, a council decides, a wrong belief comes apart — and nobody is humiliated, which is why it holds.

tree.name: Inescapable
tree.grants: ⛔ LAY PREMISES A BODY OF REASONING MINDS MUST EACH AGREE TO until they arrive by their own reasoning at a conclusion they would have fled — AND THEY CANNOT ACT AGAINST IT while it holds. A council, a court, a company.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It must be honest. A reasoning mind that finds the false premise is freed, and knows you tried.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS COMPULSION AND NUMBERS. Lay premises they must each agree to until they arrive by their own reasoning at a conclusion they would have fled — AND THEY CANNOT ACT AGAINST IT while it holds. Works on a whole body of reasoning minds at once: a council, a court, a company.

tree.name: Only Consistent Act
tree.grants: ⛔ WALK ONE PERSON TO THE CONCLUSION WHERE THE CONSISTENT ACT IS A FINAL ONE — that the post cannot be held, that they should not continue — AND THEN STOP TALKING. Built as a written or taught case, it goes on working after you have gone.
tree.cannot: ⛔ One person for the final form, and it cannot be withdrawn. Everyone who heard it heard it.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS FINALITY AND PERSISTENCE. Walk one person to the conclusion where the consistent act is a final one — that the post cannot be held, that they should not continue — AND THEN STOP TALKING. ⚠️ It also no longer needs you present: built as a written or taught case, it goes on working after you have gone.
tree._harmRungWas: ⛔ 'severe' is not a rung. -> lethal: grants walk a person to a final act — this is the one rung it has to be (Aevi 2026-08-23)

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-450: MERGES The Stated Case (syllogist) and The Necessary Case (cogitant), which did the same job at different energy costs. Erik: 'could be Case Closed, and the flavour goes internal like the move skills did.' ⚠️ RETAGGED SOCIAL — this was `reveal/command/bind` and it is persuasion. ⚠️ ERIK: 'NO to the r3 cost — the case doesn't have to be true.' Removed.

intensity.conserve: settle the narrow question and leave the rest standing
intensity.surge: ⛔ TAKE IT ALL THE WAY TO THE CONCLUSION; nobody in the room will be able to unsee where it went

abilities.plainly: A social action that settles a matter. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.
abilities.notFor: Anyone who will not engage; a matter nobody is actually arguing about; speed — a case takes as long as it takes.

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST BE WILLING TO FOLLOW. Does nothing to someone who refuses to hear it
you must actually understand the matter — a case you have not done the work on comes apart
the time and standing you spend making it

abilities.name: Proof-Halls
abilities.description: ⛔ TWO THOUSAND YEARS OF ARGUMENTS, KEPT IN ORDER, WITH THEIR ERRORS ANNOTATED BY THE PEOPLE WHO MADE THEM. A Syllogist at this reach does not reason alone — they consult a corpus that has been wrong in every recorded way and wrote down each one. ⚠️ **THE POWER IS NOT THE PROOFS. IT IS THE ANNOTATED FAILURES.** ⛔ Ask the Halls what is wrong with a thing and they will tell you which of the four hundred previously-catalogued ways of being wrong you are currently using.
abilities.narrationHints: He is quiet for a long moment, and it is not thinking — it is looking something up. ⚠️ 'This has been tried,' he says. 'Eleven times. Nine of them failed the same way, and I can tell you which way you are about to.'
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT ANSWERS FROM THE RECORD, SO A GENUINELY NEW PROBLEM GETS YOU LESS — the Halls are magnificent on the eleventh instance and nearly useless on the first. ⚠️ AND IT REASONS; IT DOES NOT PERCEIVE: it will not tell you what is in the room, only what follows from what you already know. ⛔ IT ALSO ANSWERS HONESTLY ABOUT YOUR OWN ARGUMENT, which practitioners describe as the hardest part of the craft and the reason the Halls are trusted.
abilities.plainly: An investigate/puzzle action, and the Syllogist capstone. ⛔ CONSULT TWO THOUSAND YEARS OF ANNOTATED ARGUMENT: learn whether a thing has been tried, how it failed, and which failure you are walking into. Rated 7. ⚠️ IT ANSWERS FROM PRECEDENT — magnificent on a known problem, weak on a new one — and it will tell you the error in YOUR reasoning as readily as anyone else's.

intensity.conserve: a quick consultation — has this been tried, and did it work
intensity.surge: ⛔ THE WHOLE CORPUS ON ONE QUESTION; you will get the answer and four hundred years of qualifications with it

bounds.text: ⛔ IT ANSWERS FROM THE RECORD. A genuinely new problem gets you very little
⛔ IT REASONS, IT DOES NOT PERCEIVE — nothing about what is in the room
⚠️ IT ANSWERS HONESTLY ABOUT YOUR OWN ARGUMENT, and Syllogists consider that the point
⚠️ AND CONSULTATION TAKES TIME — this is a library, not an instinct

crit.success: The Halls hold a case so close to yours that the annotation reads as if written for you.
crit.failure: You find your own argument in the record, filed under an error you had not noticed making.

mechanic.note: reveal/capstone. ⛔ THE SYLLOGISTS HAD SIX CRAFTS AND NO CAPSTONE — L1–L3, the shortest ladder in the game — and `the_proof_halls` was sitting authored as a place: 'every argument the Syllogists have ever made, kept, in order, WITH ITS ERRORS ANNOTATED BY THE PEOPLE WHO MADE THEM. A two-thousand-year exercise in PUBLIC HUMILITY.' ✅ FOURTH TIME THE GEOGRAPHY HELD A CRAFT THE TRADITION LACKED (PIPELINE rule 16). ⚠️ AND THE CRAFT'S SUBJECT IS THE ANNOTATED FAILURES RATHER THAN THE PROOFS, which is what makes it Syllogist and not merely a research craft: their profile is 'GENUINELY HUMBLE in the specific sense that they will abandon any position the moment it is shown false.' ⛔ Its own bound enforces that — it answers honestly about YOUR argument.

tree.name: Proof-Halls
tree.grants: ⛔ ASK THE RECORD: has this been tried, by whom, and how did it fail? ⚠️ You get the precedent and the annotation — including which of the catalogued errors you are currently making.
tree.cannot: ⛔ From the record only. ⚠️ A new problem gets you little, and it takes time.

abilities._authored: ⛔ THE PLACE WAS AUTHORED AND THE CRAFT WAS NOT — after `the_lensward`, `the slow orchard` and `the_mercy_house`. ✅ SINGLE RANK: a corpus either holds your case or it does not, and 'more consultation' is not a ladder — same shape as `worldsong` and `light_borne`.

_schemaFix: ⛔ SNG-452. Erik: 'make sure you're authoring with FULL SCHEMA CORRECTNESS.' ⚠️ ALL NINE ABILITIES I AUTHORED THIS SESSION WERE INCOMPLETE — the merged three missing axes/notFor/operativeAxis/bounds and every rank missing gains/harmRung; the six ranged missing cannot/functions/gains/harmRung on every rank. ⛔ I CHECKED THE CONTENT AND NOT THE SHAPE, which is the same failure as verifying content and not address.
_gainAxes: ⛔ SNG-468: `gainAxes` derived per rank from the rank's own text. ⚠️ MY MATRIX HAD BEEN READING UNPOPULATED RANKS AS 'ADDS NOTHING' — Erik caught it on Borrowed Form, whose ranks are an hour / a day plus a passenger / the whole party. THE SKILL WAS FINE; THE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
